title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
description: Obi-Wan Kenobi spent years in isolated exile on Tatooine, watching over the boy he believed would eventually bring balance to the Force. When he received Princess Leia's message, delivered to him by Luke Skywalker and a familiar pair of Droids, Obi-Wan finally left the desert planet to train Luke and confront his former pupil, Anakin Skywalker, once and for all.
